show_alert.name: Show alert
show_alert.description: Covers the pad's keys with an alert.

color.name: Color
color.description: The alert's color. Strong amber if left empty.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Take the alert away after this long. 0 keeps it until a press.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: A camera whose picture fills the alert.

show_on_key.name: Show on a key
show_on_key.description: Shows words, an icon, a camera or a picture on one key for a while, over whatever that key shows. Pressing the key takes it away and does nothing else.

key.name: Key
key.description: The key's number, counted from 1 across then down, or a control's name such as key_3.

control.name: Control
control.description: The key's control name, such as key_3, instead of its number.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Shown above the words. Without words or a picture, a bell is shown.

color.name: Color
color.description: The key's color. Strong amber if left empty.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long it stays. 0 keeps it until the key is pressed. 30 if left empty.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: A camera whose live picture fills the key.

picture.name: Picture
picture.description: A picture that fills the key: an image entity (image.door), a path on Home Assistant (/local/door.png), a web address, or a data: address.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: How the camera or picture fills the key: fill (the default), fit or stretch.

clear_on_key.name: Clear a key
clear_on_key.description: Takes away what Show on a key put on a key, or on all the pad's keys if no key is given.

key.name: Key
key.description: The key's number, counted from 1 across then down, or a control's name such as key_3.

control.name: Control
control.description: The key's control name, such as key_3, instead of its number.
